name: 戴珍珠的灰兔
baseline_scene_en: An adult grey rabbit woman looks back over one shoulder, indigo blue cloth wrapped around the base of her long natural rabbit ears, ivory collar, muted ochre jacket, one tiny pear-shaped pearl earring. Deep umber background. Softly painted grey fur and dignified calm expression. Broad light on the face and one tiny pearl glint. Original animal-world interpretation of the over-the-shoulder composition in Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring. Only rabbit anatomy, not a human face wearing rabbit ears.
